title: C64, Spectrum and DOS engine/source discoveries
summary: Add twelve qualified game and system-source projects after reviewing 32 roots; record twenty deferrals and derivative cases.
notes: Root personally searched all six requested platform families and reviewed 32 pinned roots. Twelve qualified game/reconstruction/application entries and twenty deferrals or duplicate-adjacent cases. No discovery worker used. Separate original-author remakes, source preservation, subsystem research and unfinished engines; do not infer fidelity from screenshots or a README claim. No upstream software executed. Pinned bytes are ephemeral local review material only; retained submission carries immutable proof identities without source excerpts.

sources.reason: Detokenized original BASIC and line/variable notes accompany a semantic Java oil-market remake. Oil.java reproduces the documented price formula, but uses a new random generator; planned improvements and network play are not original-game fidelity.

RULES.md connects original BASIC lines and formulas to a Go engine and Svelte browser client, explicitly separating original mechanics from remake changes. Includes Kaiser II ideas, simultaneous network rounds and balance changes; historical mill bug and BASIC boolean semantics are documented.

C++ gameplay routines reference original functions and consume original RES data. ship_sim.cpp implements ship-state mechanics without emulating x86 registers. Current status reports end-to-end play; modern AI/weapons, floating-point changes and remaining mode gaps qualify fidelity.

C/SGDK implementation contains fixed-point ball and racket projection, scoring and simple proximity/speed AI, alongside Python/Lua prototypes. This is a concrete game prototype, not all original opponents or exact physics.
Pygame remake with tile levels, keys, player and enemies in the_bank.py and supporting source. Author describes a learning project and work in progress; not a recovered original engine.

Source implements six linked rooms, elves and collecting sleigh pieces, then a gift-selection phase using tiled maps. These two phases provide concrete reconstruction evidence; a complete game is not established.

Annotated TR-DOS 5.03 disassembly for understanding Solo Forth disk compatibility. Automated z80dasm output and Vim cleanup feed Pasmo reassembly/diff; TODO records unresolved routines, code/data misclassification and ROM documentation errors.

Paul Hughes annotated assembly reconstructs Nigel Alderton Chuckie Egg, with SJAsmPlus snapshot support and configurable Fuller Orator/music/cheats. README notes unused original data removal and source snippets, so strict original byte identity is not established.

Self-contained game.html implements gameplay in JavaScript. ENGINE.md maps long/short game-loop passes, physics and AI; reported transition and pixel comparisons are upstream claims. An unexplained TIME-chain discrepancy uses measured timing, and attribute decoding remains incomplete.
Unity 3D C64 Rambo remake candidate; inspected documentation does not establish original mechanics or reconstructed engine coverage.
Small movement prototype; original transfer game and full Paradroid mechanics not established.
Movement, camera and door scripts form an early prototype; transfer mechanics and full original gameplay not evidenced.
Own procedural art/music and redesigned five-level remake; original rules or data recovery not established.
Minimal learning-project documentation does not establish original OEL BASIC analysis.
Redesigned React oil economy with achievements and weekly time; distinct from original BASIC analysis in Zabbum/oel-remake.
2.5D redesign with manual/screenshot-informed Original Mode; original source or engine parity not established.
Original DOS COM recovery relates to the already tracked RikusW/digger-unix original DOS C recovery lane; avoid duplicate listing without distinct scope.
New 2026 Spectrum homebrew, not reconstruction of an older game; held for a homebrew-focused pass.
Documentation explicitly disclaims being a clone; hybrid Celtic Legends/Heroes/Civilization design with reused units is not original-engine reconstruction.
Early Python GUI/network board project; source imports a missing crypto package and full original rules are not established.
Incomplete historical Irrlicht remake candidate with insufficient original-game provenance and coverage.
Early Java grid/tile prototype with no sufficient original-game reconstruction documentation.
Biplane dogfight design and custom physics; original source or mechanics reconstruction not established.
Explicit placeholder: source withheld pending permission for assets; no public reconstruction source to classify.
Repository name is misleading for this evidence: inspected ENGINE.md and NOTES-game.md concern Chuckie Egg, with ENGINE.md matching Chuckie-Egg-JS. Do not add a Gauntlet reconstruction on this basis.

source_updates.reason: Since 1.1.0 the game uses its own semantic C++ engine, with a CPU oracle confined to tests. Four tables consume original data and scripts. Documented differences cover key polling, ball/rules ordering, random numbers, timing and collision behaviour; replay compatibility intentionally preserves some non-original behaviour.

Dave Townsend identifies this as an iOS reimplementation of his Amiga game. BATGame.m implements hex-map units, orders, sightings, combat and reinforcements. README lists missing Confederate attack AI, hardwired movement points, retreat-zone bugs and UI/reinforcement failures.

YTM 1999 commented GEOS KERNAL disassembly includes address-labelled keyboard, interrupt and callback routines. Build includes disk/input drivers and OS segments. Modified bootstrap, removed installation and macro byte-order changes qualify upstream similarity claims.
Inspected client country rendering and UI source, but original rules recovery and a complete strategy simulation are not established.
Apple II Apparat PROM Blaster disassembly, not a DOS game; outside this six-platform discovery focus.
Amiga 4K intro sound reconstruction rather than a game or application in this pass.
Umbrella index of separate source repositories, not a distinct game reconstruction; individual roots should be deduplicated separately.
